row.name: ConocoPhillips Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=1 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.24 tightness=2.35 base_volume_vs_leg=1.4 base_volume_vs_avg=1.39
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 1 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close -1.0% vs its 20-SMA, 2.0% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base is a single session — a one-bar 'consolidation' is not a consolidation by any reading of Bonde's method, and the checklist itself records C: FAIL for this reason. Compounding that, the burst bar shows no range expansion (only 35% of the prior 5-bar range) and volume actually fell 19% from the prior session, so there is no evidence of accumulation or urgency behind the move. The chart confirms the picture: the signal bar is a modest recovery candle after a sharp red day, not a breakout from an orderly tight base.
claude.key_risk: COP is a large-cap energy name in a multi-month uptrend that has already run 37% from the June low, and this 'burst' is simply a one-day bounce off a 6% down day with no structural base beneath it.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open regardless of price action — the absence of any real consolidation structure means there is no valid Momentum Burst setup here to enter.

row.summary: COP: +0.5% on 0.8× volume out of a base 6.5% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
